課程綱要.課程目標: 本課程將帶領學生了解軟體資訊系統在開發之前的規劃、分析、設計與實作，已及開發過程中的專案管理。本課程並且著重在運用UML來信型系統的分析設計。學生在休完這堂課將具備完整的系統開發概念，並且有能力將分析設計內容對應到實際的程式內容。

課程綱要.課程目標: This course aims to ground students in the foundations of current Management Information Systems while guiding them to explore paradigm shifts and future developments in the age of Artificial Intelligence. The objective is to provide students with a comprehensive overview of MIS development over nearly six decades, enabling them to understand the essence and evolutionary trajectory of the field, and then prepare them to critically examine how AI and other cutting-edge innovations are transforming information systems, reshaping organizational structures, and changing business practices. Through this learning journey, students will develop critical thinking abilities, gain practical experience with AI-driven tools, and cultivate the adaptability needed to thrive in an unpredictable technological frontier. Ultimately, this course seeks to prepare forward-thinking MIS professionals who can bridge current practices with future possibilities, embrace uncertainty as opportunity, and lead innovation in the ongoing transformation of information systems.
課程綱要.授課內容:
Recognizing that MIS has evolved continuously since its emergence in the United States in 1968, this course embraces the dynamic nature of our field as it adapts to ever-changing technologies. Like explorers venturing into uncharted territories, MIS professionals must navigate landscapes where each breakthrough brings unexpected challenges and opportunities.
This course prepares students for such exploration by integrating established theories with practical applications and emerging technologies. Students will first master core MIS principles, then examine how AI innovations drive changes in information systems, decision-making, and business models. Through theoretical inquiry, hands-on assignments, and collaborative projects, students will be equipped for future challenges.

課程綱要.課程目標: Social network analysis is one of the most ideal ways of data-oriented to understand network society social phenomena. The objectives of this course are: (1) to discover how social networks and human dynamics create social systems and recognizable patterns (2) to transform data for analysis using graph-based and statistics-based social network measures; (3) to visualize network data using different methods and packages; (4) to apply node and group level social network measures; (5) to build and test network models at the nodal, dyadic and network levels; (6) to choose among social network designs based on research goals; (7) to examine social networks analysis using case studies.

課程綱要.課程目標: "The aim of this course is to provide students general knowledge of information retrieval. The first part focuses on the basic concept and theory of information retrieval. 課程綱要.課程目標: 本課程目標有以下： (1) 理解供應鏈管理的基本概念與重要性：學生將能理解供應鏈管理的核心概念、功能與在企業競爭中的關鍵角色。 (2) 掌握供應鏈各個環節的運作模式與協調機制：學生能分析供應鏈中採購、生產、物流、配送與資訊流之間的相互關係，並理解其整合的重要性。 (3) 學習供應鏈策略規劃與決策分析工具：學生能運用便利的工具（如需求預測、供應鏈網絡設計等）進行供應鏈規劃與優化。 (4) 了解全球供應鏈管理與永續發展的趨勢：學生將能探討全球化背景下的供應鏈挑戰，如風險管理、道德採購、綠色供應鏈與科技應用。
課程綱要.授課內容: 課程內容主要是包含以下幾大主題：Building a strategic framework to analyze supply chains, designing the supply chain network, planning and coordinating demand and supply in a supply chain, planning and managing inventories in a supply chain, designing and planning transportation networks, and managing cross-functional drivers in a supply chain. 課程由兩位教師共同教授。陳老師的部分：除了上述教學內容之外，每周將有學生小組進行當周次主題的個案分享。張李老師的部分：主要講授經濟對供應鏈管理的分析方法，同學需報告經濟模型在供應鏈管理上的相關應用論文。

課程綱要.課程目標: Upon completion of this course, students will be able to: • Gain insight into the interdisciplinary field of data science. • Analyze data using machine learning techniques. • Conduct scientific literature review on related techniques. • Understand the components of Internet of Things • Understand the impact of IoT on society • Understand the components of an embedded system • Understand the architecture of an IoT system in terms of software and hardware • Implement basic programs for an IoT device • Implement a simple IoT system with cloud-based services
課程綱要.授課內容: As more and more devices in homes, cars, factories, hospitals and many other premises are connected to the Internet, it is becoming increasingly necessary to provide solutions to link them together, gather and analyze data from them. This course aims to introduce how data analytics and IoT work together to provide intelligent solutions. Students will familiarize themselves with the concepts of “Internet of Things“ and their basic applications, and learn how hardware and software interface with each other, how IoT components are connected and how to implement an IoT application along with data analytic capability.

課程綱要.課程名稱(英文): Introduction to Modern and Post-quantum Cryptography
課程綱要.課程目標: 密碼學是保障現代數位系統安全的關鍵技術，應用範圍包括電子商務、網路安全、金融交易以及個人資料隱私。 本課程將從古典密碼學開始介紹，接著介紹現代密碼學，內容涵蓋常見的加解密技術與數位簽章機制。另外，考量到量子計算發展對現有密碼技術帶來的潛在威脅，本課程也將涵蓋後量子密碼學，說明可抵抗量子攻擊的新型技術。
課程綱要.授課內容:
課程將包含以下內容：
1. 古典密碼學 – 密碼學基礎與歷史背景
2. 現代密碼學：
- 對稱式密碼學 – 區塊加密、流加密、雜湊函數、認證加密
- 非對稱式密碼學 – 金鑰交換、加解密、數位簽章、其餘進階主題
4. 後量子密碼學 – 基於晶格密碼學
課程綱要.教科書/參考書: 1. Understanding Cryptography: From Established Symmetric and Asymmetric Ciphers to Post-Quantum Algorithms, Second Edition, Christof Paar, Jan Pelzl, Tim Güneysu 2. A Graduate Course in Applied Cryptography (v.06), Dan Boneh and Victor Shoup 3. An Introduction to Mathematical Cryptography, J.H. Silverman, Jill Pipher, Jeffrey Hoffstein 4. Introduction to Modern Cryptography, Third Edition, Jonathan Katz and Yehuda Lindell
